title: itsnas.me — Writing
subtitle: Thoughts, tutorials, and engineering notes from real-world projects.

posts.title: Keep Your UI Copy in One Place
posts.description: All of the site's copy moves out of components into one central file, and components read it through `t('key')`. The keys are typed against that file, so they autocomplete, and a typo or a deleted line fails the type-check instead of shipping blank.

posts.title: Don't Drop Focus When the Button Disappears
posts.description: Click "Show all" on a collapsed block and the button unmounts, taking keyboard focus with it: the next Tab starts from the top of the page. `useCollapsible` moves focus to whatever replaced the button.

posts.title: Show More Only When It's Cut Off
posts.description: `line-clamp` cuts text off, but it can't tell your JavaScript whether it did, so every short description gets a pointless "Show more". `useOverflow` measures the element and answers that one question.
